facts.statement: Fossils of Ilchunaia have been found in the Divisadero Largo Formation of Argentina from the Late Eocene.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from the Divisadero Largo Formation of Argentina dating back to the Late Eocene

facts.statement: Fossils of Ilchunaia have also been found in a locality in Mendoza, Argentina, dating to the Oligocene.
facts.quote: and a locality in Mendoza, Argentina dating back to the Oligocene.

facts.statement: Very little material is known about Ilchunaia, as only the anterior portion of the skull remains for study because the holotype was lost.
facts.quote: Little material is known from the genus, with only the anterior portion of the skull being present to study (the holotype has since been lost).

facts.statement: Recent phylogenetic analyses suggest that Sebecosuchidae is entirely paraphyletic, with members likely being basal sebecosuchians ancestral to baurusuchids.
facts.quote: The placement of Ilchunaia within Sebecosuchidae has been questioned in the past, and many recent phylogenetic analyses have shown the family to be entirely paraphyletic, with members most likely being basal sebecosuchians ancestral to the baurusuchids.

facts.statement: Ilchunaia is classified within the family Sebecidae.
Fossils of Ilchunaia were found in the Divisadero Largo Formation of Argentina from the Late Eocene and in a locality in Mendoza from the Oligocene.
facts.quote: Sus fósiles han sido hallados en la formación Divisadero Largo de Argentina, que datan de finales del Eoceno, y de una localidad en Mendoza, que se remonta hasta el periodo Oligoceno.

facts.statement: Little material is known about this genus, with only the anterior part of the skull available for study because the holotype has been lost.
facts.quote: Se conoce poco material de este género, con sólo la parte anterior del cráneo disponible para su estudio (el holotipo se ha perdido).

facts.statement: The classification of Ilchunaia within Sebecosuchidae has been questioned, and recent analyses show the family was entirely paraphyletic, with some members likely being basal sebecosuchians ancestral to baurusuchids.
facts.quote: La clasificación de Ilchunaia dentro de Sebecosuchidae ha sido cuestionada en el pasado, y muchos análisis filogenéticos recientes han mostrado que la familia era enteramente parafilética, con algunos miembros siendo probablemente sebecosuquios basales ancestrales a los baurusúquidos.

facts.statement: Ilchunaia lived from the Lutetian to the Priabonian, between 42 and 36 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Lutetian to Priabonian (42 to 36 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Ilchunaia is an extinct genus of sebecid mesoeucrocodylian.
rejected.quote: Ilchunaia is an extinct genus of sebecid mesoeucrocodylian.
